message: No detected input validation: The Adult dataset loader drops NaN values and filters one country value but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming CSV data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from local CSV files with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or authentication of any kind.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only encodes labels as category codes and drops NaN values; there is no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected set, or use of label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs normalization and missing-value dropping but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms aimed at defending against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded with torch.load(checkpoint) after only checking os.path.isfile(), with no hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision to ensure integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: The code balances the dataset via get_minimum_df but does not explicitly validate label distribution or check for expected label sets before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or anomaly detection on gradients anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation of a held-out test set from training data enforced at evaluation time, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics; predictions are compared directly against labels with no integrity controls.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path passes data directly to model.predict() and torch operations with no shape, range, type, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs from torch.argmax() are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before being stored and displayed.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular classification model (FcNet/ConvNet/RandomForest on Adult dataset), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
